findings.highlight: I take a deep breath and open my eyes.
findings.evidenceJa: ほう、と息をついて目蓋を開けた。
findings.governingReading: Recognizing the time, Shirou lets out a breath and opens his eyes.
findings.explanation: Shirou's exhalation becomes a deep inhalation.

findings.highlight: "Oh, okay. Good idea, Senpai."
findings.evidenceJa: 「あ、はい。ごくろうさまです、先輩」
findings.governingReading: Sakura accepts the breakfast request and politely acknowledges the trouble or effort involved in waking Taiga.
findings.explanation: Sakura's acknowledgment of Shirou's trouble becomes approval of his idea.

findings.highlight: Illya fumes at Sakura as she stomps over to the shed.
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤは怒鳴りながら土蔵へ走っていく。
findings.governingReading: Still shouting at Sakura, Illya runs toward the shed.
findings.explanation: Illya running to the shed while shouting becomes stomping toward it.

findings.highlight: In fact, Sakura has regained her usual cheer thanks to Illya.
findings.evidenceJa: 実際、イリヤのおかげで桜は元気を取り戻しつつある。
findings.governingReading: Thanks to Illya, Sakura is in the process of regaining her cheer.
findings.explanation: Sakura's ongoing recovery becomes completed restoration.

findings.highlight: Nobody will like you if you're so stingy at such a young age."
findings.evidenceJa: 若い頃からお金にうるさいとまわりの子に嫌われちゃうぞー」
findings.governingReading: Taiga warns that being strict about money from a young age will make the other children around Illya dislike her.
findings.explanation: Dislike from the children around Illya becomes rejection by everyone.

findings.highlight: "That's okay. As long as the person I like doesn't think like that, I don't care what anyone else thinks. Oh, by the way, Taiga, I want the money you borrowed the other day back. It was payday five days ago, right?"
findings.evidenceJa: 「嫌われて結構よ。好きな人以外なら何を思われても関係ないもの。それよりタイガ、貸したお金ちゃんと返してよね。給料日、五日前だったんでしょ」
findings.governingReading: Illya does not care what anyone other than the people she likes thinks of her.
findings.explanation: People Illya likes become a singular person she likes.

findings.highlight: "Raiga told me. I can give you the details of the conversation if you like."
findings.evidenceJa: 「ライガに聞いたわ。お望みなら明細まで話してあげてよ」
findings.governingReading: After citing Raiga as the source of Taiga's payday information, Illya offers to recite the itemized details.
findings.explanation: Payroll details become details of a conversation.

findings.highlight: "Hmph. She might as well just live in this house, for all I care...dummy."
findings.evidenceJa: 「……ふん。いっそのコトここの子になっちゃえ、ばか」
findings.governingReading: Sulking, Taiga says Illya might as well become a child of this household.
findings.explanation: Becoming a child of Shirou's household becomes merely living there.

findings.highlight: Schools are starting the new school year, and the season has gone from the cold of winter to spring.
findings.evidenceJa: 学校では入学式があって、季節は寒い冬を越えて春になっている。
findings.governingReading: On April seventh, Shirou's school is holding its entrance ceremony as the season turns to spring.
findings.explanation: The school's entrance ceremony becomes schools generally starting a new year.

findings.highlight: "But is this really a coincidence? We run into each other almost every day.
findings.evidenceJa: 「けど奇遇か？　ここ最近よくニアミスするだろ。
findings.governingReading: Shirou questions whether today's meeting is coincidence because lately he and Rin have often narrowly missed one another.
findings.explanation: Repeated near misses become repeated meetings.

findings.highlight: I don't think getting angry so early in the morning is good for you.
findings.evidenceJa: 朝っぱらから、ここで会ったが百年目、なんてオーラをちらつかせるのはよくないと思う。
findings.governingReading: Shirou jokes that Rin is radiating the hostile air of the idiom 'meeting here after a hundred years,' as if this were a long-awaited showdown.
findings.explanation: Rin's mock 'at last I have found you' aura disappears.

findings.highlight: "Tohsaka, did you start leaving your house earlier? You always arrived later. You were never early or late to school."
findings.evidenceJa: 「遠坂、もしかして登校時間変えたのか？　前はもうちょっと遅かっただろ。早すぎず遅すぎずって時間だった」
findings.governingReading: Shirou recalls that Rin used to come down later, at a time that was neither too early nor too late for this route.
findings.explanation: Rin's earlier intersection timing becomes school punctuality.

findings.highlight: "Tohsaka. You must be exhausted."
findings.evidenceJa: 「遠坂。おまえ、眠くない？」
findings.governingReading: Shirou directly asks Rin whether she is sleepy.
findings.explanation: A question about sleepiness becomes an assertion of exhaustion.

findings.highlight: Like, "Who dares disturb my slumber" kind of terrifying.
findings.evidenceJa: こう、我が眠りヲ妨げる者ニぶっ殺す、みたいな。
findings.governingReading: Shirou caricatures morning Rin as saying, roughly, 'I will kill whoever disturbs my sleep.'
findings.explanation: The imagined awakened demon's murder threat is removed.

findings.highlight: "Huh? Is that bad? Illya seemed bored, so I thought this would be a good distraction."
findings.evidenceJa: 「？　なんかまずいか？　イリヤだって暇つぶしになるって喜ぶと思うんだが」
findings.governingReading: Shirou thinks Illya would be pleased because the school visit would pass the time.
findings.explanation: Shirou's prediction that Illya will welcome the diversion becomes an observation that she seemed bored.

findings.highlight: Illya still doesn't fully understand that she needs to hide the fact that she's a mage, so Tohsaka's been a great mentor for her in that regard.
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師である事を隠して生きていく、という事をいまいち実感していないイリヤにとって、遠坂はいい先生になると思うのだ。
findings.governingReading: Shirou thinks Rin will make a good teacher for Illya, who does not yet grasp living while hiding magecraft.
findings.explanation: Rin's potential as a teacher becomes an established mentoring record.

findings.highlight: The new priest the Church dispatched has already repaired most of the damage from the Holy Grail War, and we've more or less gone back into our ordinary lives.
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯戦争によって起きた被害は、教会に派遣された新しい神父によって元の形に戻りつつあるし、俺たちの日常もこうして問題なく帰ってきた。
findings.governingReading: The Holy Grail War's damage is in the process of being returned to its former state by the newly dispatched priest.
findings.explanation: Damage still being restored becomes damage already mostly repaired.

findings.highlight: "That's why I was worried that was going to happen. You know, there are times it's more normal to get spectacularly depressed."
findings.evidenceJa: 「だから、わたしはそれが心配だった。ああいう時はね、いっそ派手に落ち込んでくれた方が周りは安心するものなの」
findings.governingReading: Rin says that in such a situation, the people around someone feel safer if that person becomes spectacularly depressed.
findings.explanation: Visible grief reassuring other people becomes grief being more normal.

findings.highlight: So that's why you're not depressed, and you're just going to drown in your memories."
findings.evidenceJa: だから落ち込む事もなく、思い出に浸る事もないってわけ」
findings.governingReading: Rin concludes that because Shirou has settled the matter, he neither sinks into depression nor immerses himself in memories.
findings.explanation: Not dwelling in memories becomes drowning in them.

findings.highlight: I head up the hill under the same blue sky she looked up and saw.
findings.evidenceJa: いつか彼女も見ただろう青空の下、坂道を上っていく。
findings.governingReading: Shirou climbs beneath the blue sky that she too would, at some time, presumably have seen.
findings.explanation: A sky Saber would probably have seen becomes one she definitely saw.

findings.highlight: The knight runs to her.
findings.evidenceJa: 騎士は走っていた。
findings.governingReading: The knight is running through the battlefield while leading the wounded white horse carrying the king.
findings.explanation: The knight running with the horse and king becomes running toward Saber.

findings.highlight: Or rather...he hopes.
findings.evidenceJa: 否—そう信じるしか、出来なかった。
findings.governingReading: The knight did not truly possess certainty; he could do nothing except force himself to believe the king would recover.
findings.explanation: Having no choice but to believe becomes merely hoping.

findings.highlight: But the knight was proud of the young king, who never revealed any personal feelings, no matter the situation, and always remained idealistic.
findings.evidenceJa: その窮地において私情を見せず、常に理想であり続けた若い王を誇りにさえ思った。
findings.governingReading: The young king showed no private feeling in extremity and continued always to embody the ideal.
findings.explanation: The king remaining an ideal becomes the king remaining idealistic.

findings.highlight: He wants so much to see his king's true face...not the stern countenance the king bore on the battlefield, but his king's true face...a smiling, laughing, human face.
findings.evidenceJa: 王城や戦場で見せる顔ではなく、素顔の、人間としての笑い顔が見たかった。
findings.governingReading: Bedivere wants a human smile unlike the face the king shows at the royal castle or on the battlefield.
findings.explanation: The king's public faces at court and on the battlefield become only a stern battlefield countenance.

findings.highlight: He reached the rank of imperial guard and stood guard at the king's side.
findings.evidenceJa: 近衛を任され、王の身辺を守るに至った。
findings.governingReading: Bedivere is entrusted with the close guard and protects the king's person.
findings.explanation: A royal bodyguard post becomes an imperial guard rank.

findings.highlight: Why does that make him so angry?
findings.evidenceJa: それに怒りを覚えたのはいつからだろう。
findings.governingReading: The knight wonders from what point he came to feel anger at never seeing the king at ease.
findings.explanation: Wondering when anger began becomes asking why the fact causes anger.

findings.highlight: The knight bows to his half-conscious king, and returns to his white steed.
findings.evidenceJa: もはや意識のない王に礼をし、騎士は白馬へとって返す。
findings.governingReading: Bedivere bows to a king who is no longer conscious and turns back toward the horse; the following narration is surprised that the supposedly unconscious king speaks.
findings.explanation: The unconscious king becomes half-conscious.

findings.highlight: The knight's voice is imploring.
findings.evidenceJa: 探るように声をかける。
findings.governingReading: Bedivere answers in a testing or searching tone to keep the king's uncertain consciousness engaged.
findings.explanation: Bedivere's probing reply becomes imploring.

findings.highlight: The king's life is balanced on the tip of a blade. The darkness will surely take his king if the knight does not respond.
findings.evidenceJa: 王の意識は確かではない。こうして聞き返さねば、また闇の中へ落ちるだろう。
findings.governingReading: The king's consciousness is not secure; unless Bedivere asks back like this, the king will fall again into darkness.
findings.explanation: Uncertain consciousness becomes a life balanced on a blade.

findings.highlight: "Yes. I have not had many dreams, so it was valuable experience."
findings.evidenceJa: 「そうだ。あまり見た事がないのでな。貴重な体験をした」
findings.governingReading: The king says dreams are rare for him, so he has had a valuable experience.
findings.explanation: The king's sentence is missing an article in English.

findings.highlight: The knight's words must have been unexpected.
findings.evidenceJa: 騎士の言葉に、何か意外なものでもあったかのように。
findings.governingReading: The faint gasp sounds as though something in Bedivere's words surprised the king.
findings.explanation: An appearance of surprise becomes a certain explanation.

findings.highlight: It is the first and last time he will do such a thing.
findings.evidenceJa: これが最初で最後の、王に対する不正と詫びて。
findings.governingReading: He lies while inwardly apologizing that this is his first and last act of wrongdoing against his king.
findings.explanation: Bedivere's apology for his first and last injustice against the king disappears.

findings.highlight: The king's soft voice is admirable.
findings.evidenceJa: 王は感心するように呟く。
findings.governingReading: The king murmurs as though impressed by Bedivere's supposed knowledge.
findings.explanation: The king's admiration of Bedivere becomes the king's voice being admirable.

findings.highlight: A white hand emerges from the water and catches the blade, and the sacred sword vanishes from the world.
findings.evidenceJa: 水面より現れた皓い腕が剣を受け止め、三度空を巡ったあと、聖剣はこの世界から消失した。
findings.governingReading: A white arm catches the sword, it circles the sky three times, and then the sacred sword vanishes from the world.
findings.explanation: The sword's three circuits through the sky are omitted.

findings.highlight: The responsibilities that had so long burdened the knight finally come to an end.
findings.evidenceJa: その、あまりに長かった責務が、ここにこうして終わったのだと。
findings.governingReading: Bedivere accepts that the king's end has come and that her exceedingly long responsibility is now finished.
findings.explanation: The king's exceptionally long duty becomes the knight's burden.

findings.highlight: "I've thrown the sword into the lake. It is back in the hands of the Lady of the Lake."
findings.evidenceJa: 「—湖に剣を投げ入れてまいりました。剣は湖の婦人の手に、確かに」
findings.governingReading: Bedivere reports that the sword was certainly taken by the white arm or hand of the lake.
findings.explanation: The white arm is identified outright as the Lady of the Lake.
